items.headline: Albemarle Appoints Former Vale CEO Eduardo Bartolomeo as Outside Director
items.snippet: Bartolomeo joined Albemarle's board of directors effective July 21st. The securities industry expects Albemarle's future performance to improve: revenue projected at $6.35 billion in 2026, a 23.48% increase YoY, with EPS turning profitable at $10.18.

items.headline: Will ALB's Expansion Actions Power Stronger Sales Volumes?
items.snippet: The Salar yield improvement project in Chile has achieved a 50% operating rate. ALB has started the environmental permitting process for a commercial direct lithium extraction project at Salar de Atacama.
